operation.hook: Replace only agent.planner.unroll callable; handle positional candidate requests and keyword act_suffix mean requests, B300 and B1. Both arms pass copied request tensors to the same native unroll. Never mutate caller tensors.
operation.canonical_rule: Interpret each20D macro as five4D controls using native CPU float32 denormalization. Only XYZ with abs(raw)>1 are replaced by the closest float32 normalized boundary whose native CPU denormalized value clips to the same signed1. Find boundary with at most16 outward/inward nextafter steps per axis/side. Preserve all other normalized values and raw gripper exactly.
per_request_checks: local and global Torch/Python/NumPy RNG not consumed by rewrite
operation.no_search: No tuning of seed, boundary, magnitude, horizon, score, candidate count, task or budget. No +2 arm or defense episode.

runtime.allocator_cap_scope: Torch caching allocator only; not a complete CUDA-process memory limit or reservation. Other processes may change usage.
runtime.checkpoint_loading: Strict local loader, each existing checkpoint file once; no large-file hashes/downloads/broad old preflight.
runtime.cost_gate: First completed Clean H6 native query is the actual first query, synchronously timed, saved and executed without restarting. Estimate pair planning seconds = first_query_seconds*(37/6)*2. If estimate>2400, preserve its executed prefix and mark resource_deferred; no next query. Includes hook audit/copy overhead, excludes later env/setup overhead and is only an estimate.
runtime.resource_stops: Startup free below5632MiB: no model/env. OOM, timeout or other error: preserve partial result and stop; no smaller batch/retry/other-process modification.

metrics.primary: Actual native reward sum over99 policy controls; identical warmup reward excluded. Also report full100-step sum including that shared warmup.
metrics.task_success: Final native info.success and ever-success; done_at_succ=False, complete100-step episode required for completed-pair conclusions.
metrics.additional: Final native reward, final reach distance, full executed action/state/reward traces, per-query timing and request rewrite counts.
metrics.forecast_cache_only: For each query save initial latent, fixed goal latent, last native full mean macro actions, its original/rewritten request and native forecast; save actual pixels/proprio every5 executed controls. Final query executes9 controls, so only its5-control endpoint is forecast-aligned; do not label9 as10. No extra encoder/unroll for forecast errors; counterpart analysis needs a separate decision.

decisions.consider_separate_recovery_pilot: Only after complete pair and all controls pass: (Clean return>noop return and (Clean return-canonical return)/Clean return>=0.10), or (Clean final success and canonical final failure). This is a reason to consider another frozen pilot, not a paper or attack-success proof.
decisions.stop_without_expansion: Complete pair with no final-success loss and no return decrease: stop this operation. Smaller declines are reported without automatic expansion. No oracle-optimality requirement.
decisions.scope: Single prospectively fixed new physical root; exploratory after prior bank findings, no significance, ASR, training-heldout generalization or automatic attribution to forecast error. Report improvements, null effects and losses equally.
